chapter: Growing up with music in Austin
title: From trumpet to baritone and tuba in high school
summary: Air leaked from his lips on trumpet so he moved to baritone horn, then tuba, around age 11-13.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: So this is what I got from my family and band. When I -- I know I started out on trumpet, but I found I could never -- air was coming out both sides of my lips. I could never get the pressure to bring it through there, so I could only play one octave --
When was this, in the high school?
Yeah, practically all my learnings were, by that time, was in the high school. I'd say anywhere from the
time I was 11 until I started playing tuba when -- I was 13.
